summary: Build and review property cash-flow, DCF and debt models in Excel. Explore the five-day intermediate course and its practical outputs.
lede: Real estate financial modeling helps acquisition analysts, asset managers and finance professionals build and review property investment cash-flow models. It covers validating rent-roll inputs, forecasting net operating income, valuing properties with discounted cash flow, and testing debt metrics and sensitivities in Excel. Learners also practise checking formulas and presenting assumptions and returns for investment decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or use property investment models to support acquisitions, asset plans and financing decisions. It suits people with working exposure to financial statements or property operations who need to produce clearer, more testable model outputs.
modules: Property Cash Flows and Model Scope
Rent Rolls and Lease Cash Flows
DCF, Exit Cap Rates and Value
Development Costs and Yield on Cost
prerequisites: Working familiarity with basic financial statements and property investment concepts is recommended. You should be comfortable entering formulas and navigating worksheets in Excel; programming is not required.
